title: Credo (La Rue, Missa Tandernaken)
desc: Pierre de la Rue, Missa Tandernaken, Credo. 4 voices (Discantus, Contra, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue1030c); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py).
